name: Koori (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Koori town emblem in white: a ring with a pointed top enclosing a stylised mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Koori, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1965.

features.role: Koori town emblem — a ring with a pointed top enclosing a stylised mountain
